scope: Authorized F1 within-recording alternative; never a substitute for lawful cross-recording T3
baseline_prerequisite: Actual B0-B6 complete on all 8 registered TRAIN sequences / 52 clicks, with isolated sealed runtime then evaluation
frozen_encoder_controls: Execute actual second-ReID/general controls; fixed initial OSNet input lineage is NOT selected from outer control outcomes
input_backbone: Frozen source-SHA-verified OSNet 512-D; no backbone finetuning
candidate_axis: Same valid SAM3 UID geometry contract; no GT-driven candidate filtering
architecture: ACIB candidate architecture: shared 512-to-128 identity projection; explicit immutable anchor; bounded timestamp/source/quality/consistency bank; candidate-conditioned learned bank weighting; candidate evidence MLP; set-pooled three-class availability/NONE head; independent write-correctness/risk head
available_runtime_information: Anchor/current candidates; previous own accepted boxes, confidence, bank/camera/time metadata. No future inputs or GT identities. Unknown camera/time is explicit, not invented.
recording_reset: Reset motion/native/pending confirmations, retain anchor/token/eligible identity bank. Recency from actual continuous-clip timestamps only; no concatenated-frame time across recordings.
absence_limitation: DanceTrack GT gaps provide offline NONE availability supervision, not validated physical absence/out-of-view. This F1 model cannot satisfy cross-recording/true-physical-absence Goal gates.
T0: Shared identity ranking plus candidate/NONE and availability supervision from fit-only current-frame matching. Empty machine bank; immutable single real crop anchor. Auxiliary write correctness only uses verified matches, not unresolved candidates.
T0_inner_selection_frame_axis: All future frames, no stride; one decision per target/frame. Loss selects epoch; no outer/query access.
T0_checkpoint_tiebreak: Earlier epoch within 1e-6 inner loss. No outer target performance selection.
T1: Actual model-generated causal full-frame rollout on fit only; matched P0, P1 and mixed own-state exposure. P1 machine writes are own predictions, never teacher-forced true positives.
T2: Actual causal memory-coupled fit rollouts. Train-only posthoc future comparison may label write harm but never become online features. Explicit correct/wrong/high-uncertainty/reappearance strata; cross-recording change pending lawful metadata/media.
T3: Freeze architecture/weights/thresholds from fit+inner before independent final evaluation; CHIRLA official cross-recording protocol still unavailable and cannot be faked with local IDs or DanceTrack frames
outer_folds: 8 cyclic sequence folds: outer i, inner next sequence, other 6 fit. All have historical method exposure disclosed.
loss: Candidate+NONE NLL + 0.5 three-class availability CE + 0.2 verified-candidate write-correctness BCE. Report loss components, gradient finite/norm, inner availability/recall and nondegeneracy; no post-result coefficient tuning.
class_sampling: No future-error/event-selected fit samples; every fifth future frame for all registered targets; full inner axis. Any class reweighting must be fit-only and recorded, never outer.
AMP: CUDA float16 autocast with GradScaler; numerical diagnostics and inference probability arithmetic FP32. CPU explicitly no AMP.
resume: Per-fold/seed latest checkpoint includes model/optimizer/scaler/RNG/epoch/best-loss/patience and source/protocol/split seals. Changed code requires versioned new run, no overwrite of sealed models.
OOM_recovery: Record failure; halve batch from128 to64 then32 only within same run and identical selected samples; never terminate unrelated workloads or remove candidates
GPU: One actually idle device, 12GiB per-process allocation cap; recheck before launch
